visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A black Toyota JPN Taxi featuring prominent 'GO' branding and a matching black 'Tokyo World Kotsu' taxi are captured driving on a wide asphalt road. The camera moves in sync with the traffic, likely from the interior of another vehicle. The background consists of a lush, sunlit tree line and a vibrant blue sky filled with wispy white clouds. No human characters are distinguishable through the tinted windows or in the surrounding environment. (2) As the perspective shifts forward, a large white minivan enters the frame from the left foreground, passing the two black taxis. The natural daylight is bright and consistent, illuminating the metallic surfaces of the cars and the clear sky above. Stylized Traditional Chinese text remains anchored to the top-left area of the frame throughout the movement.

The serene piano music reinforces this mood of calm reflection.
